sloka: यश्चैष शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य विद्युत्प्रभं किङ्करवज्रवेगम् ।वृषेन्द्रमास्थाय गिरिप्रकाशमायाति यो ऽसौ त्रिशिरा यशस्वी ।। ६.५९.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: yaścaiṣa śūlaṁ niśitaṁ pragṛhya vidyutprabhaṁ kiṅkaravajravegam ।vṛṣendramāsthāya giriprakāśamāyāti yo 'sau triśirā yaśasvī ।। 6.59.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "He who comes firmly shining like lightning, surpassing thunderbolt in speed, seizing a trident, riding a Lordly bull shining like a mountain is the famous Trisira."
